scope: Selected-part printing and precise motion-link editing
tested_behaviors: Actual part checklist, current selection and clear selection
Bolt and nut exclusion preserves washers and pins; reasons remain visible
Multiple print plates, switching, manual movement and XYZ rotation
Actual VTK ray picking and Qt drag placement
Current-plate STL and all-plate ZIP with relative index and exact selected identities
STL bounds, dimensions and bottom Z=0
Oversized whole body and overlap warnings block affected output
Stale settings and changed save-picker state do not export an obsolete preview
Save-picker and mid-export cancellation preserve source history and prior output bytes
Exact motion-link editing, enabled invalid-limit blocking, Undo/Redo and Save As/reopen

visual_evidence.printing: Five actual VTK framebuffers per print run; separately composited Qt control captures
root_direct_inspection: Source manual placement and oversized warning
visual_evidence.motion: Raw Qt controls and reopened timeline; WGL black area is not geometry proof

preserved_initial_failure: First source QA clicked outside the checkbox indicator/text; 43 checks completed before failure. The fixture click was corrected without weakening stale-preview guards.
corrected_product_issue: ZIP completion shows the selected output path rather than the returned index dictionary.
limitations: Eight synthetic printing parts including a real imported BREP, plus a separate three-body motion fixture
No physical printer output, hardware strength, firmware target, load rating or tolerance qualification
Large individual bodies remain whole; splitting is across print plates
Support, infill, layers and G-code are configured in an external slicer
Name hints are unverified selection aids; unknown fastener identity stays user-controlled
Historical full2442 source tests belong to v3.0.1, not a fresh v3.1.0 full run
